name: r1_worldboss_sweep
note: R1 case E (sweep reply shape). The fixture seeds a ranked boss board where the player directly ahead of the driven player has no directory profile. The stock world_boss_sweep CSB is absent from the supplied assets (only res/windows/worldBoss/boss_rank exists), so the stock window cannot be instantiated; like i9_8a_world_boss this scenario loads WORLD_BOSS (624) and sweeps (628) through the stock model, then performs the exact read WorldBossSweepWindow.lua:35-43 makes against the model (perpose.player_name/lev/hurt when total_rank > 1). The model callback carries only the code, so the fields are read from the stock model. The window open is kept to show the intended consumer.
